definitions.gloss: very small amount; negligible quantity; trifling
definitions.explanation: An extremely small quantity or degree. Used in formal or written contexts to describe something minimal.

examples.japanese: {僅少|きんしょう}な{差|さ}で{負|ま}けた。
examples.english: I lost by a tiny margin.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}が{僅少|きんしょう}になっている。
{僅少|きんしょう}ながら{寄付|きふ}させていただきます。
examples.english: I would like to make a small donation.

notes: A formal word often seen in business correspondence, news, and written reports. {僅少|きんしょう}ながら is a humble set phrase used when offering something modest. Functions as a な-adjective when modifying nouns ({僅少|きんしょう}な{差|さ}). Related: {僅|わず}か (slight, a mere), {少量|しょうりょう} (small amount).
